svg.text: Five buildings, one per funding stage (sketch from docs/BUILDING_STAGES_PROPOSAL.md)
Top: front view (the door side, +Z toward you). Bottom: seen from above, front at the bottom. Dashed: the 60 x 60 Floor and its room; orange: the doorway lane (9 wide); gray: the 82.6-wide lot.

Same scale for all five (2.6 px per stud). Boxes only: the real Parts versions are drawn from the data in docs/previews/buildings.svg once built. Pink: the stage 5 skyline (PlotArt) behind building 5.
Series A, 76 x 72, top 20 with antenna
Series B, 80 x 72, top 36 with antenna
Green dot: the spawn landing (0, 12). Blue: the five incubators (z -25). Slate: the six upgrade stations (x +-23). Every gameplay position is the same in all five buildings.
